mapper.sql: aid, title, venue_id, location, start_time, end_time, creator_id, max_players, current_players, level_require, description, status, create_time, update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM activity WHERE creator_id = #{creatorId} ORDER BY create_time DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO activity (title, venue_id, location, start_time, end_time, creator_id, max_players, current_players, level_require, description, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{venueId}, #{location}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{creatorId}, #{maxPlayers}, #{currentPlayers}, #{levelRequire}, #{description}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE aid = #{aid}
UPDATE activity SET current_players = current_players + 1 WHERE aid = #{aid} AND current_players < max_players
UPDATE activity SET current_players = current_players - 1 WHERE aid = #{aid} AND current_players > 0
mapper.select: SELECT u.uid, u.nickname, u.avatar FROM activity_participant ap JOIN user u ON u.uid = ap.user_id WHERE ap.activity_id = #{aid}
mapper.update: UPDATE activity SET title = #{title}, venue_id = #{venueId}, location = #{location}, start_time = #{startTime}, end_time = #{endTime}, max_players = #{maxPlayers}, current_players = #{currentPlayers}, level_require = #{levelRequire}, description = #{description}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE aid = #{aid}
